about_the_game:
CHARGE! is a laser-tag inspired sport in the future. Athletes are split into teams of three and deployed into a fantastic sci-fi arena to be let loose.

Mission
Develop a futuristic themed 3v3 multiplayer FPS that blends old-school arena mechanics with modern sensibilities of fun. A fresh take on weapon functionality and gamemode approaches, focusing on the multiplayer experience.

Gameplay

  • Teams: Players will either join the Attackers or the Defenders when starting in a 3v3 match. (Want to go solo? Play with bots!)

  • Team "Attackers": Attackers will go after conquering the "Charge Line Nodes" by shooting all the nodes to the Attacker's color until all 3 sections are under the Attackers' control.

  • Team "Defenders": Defenders will defend the "Charge Line Nodes" by keeping them their color (and taking out the opposite players) to protect the nodes.

  • How to win: If Attackers get all 3 sections locked in before the timer, they win. If the Defenders are able to stop the Attackers from conquering all 3 sections, they win. 

Features

  • Play with 3 different light-based guns to take down your opponents: the "Trusty Rifle", "LetLoose" SMG, and "ShotBrite Lite" shotgun.

  • Pick up modifiers that bend the rules of what your shots can do, like ricocheting off walls with "Rebound", and bending through walls with "Prism Passthrough", to create your own advantages.

  • Use the environment's obstacles to get you to your next objective, be it at breakneck speed with launching fans, or with more precision via the map's "Data Busses".

short_description: Light it up in CHARGE!, the laser tag-inspired sport of the future! Let loose in arena-style first-person shooter action to bounce around buildings, modify your laser weapons to bend light, and take on your friends in quick matches for territory dominance.
